trace.cypher:
MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WHERE CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) >= 1967
  AND (o.name IS NULL OR o.name <> 'Jim Morris')
RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
